issues.where: the large resume-upload slab behind the arrow, especially the right and lower edges
issues.what: the slab reads immediately as an opaque gray panel; the page texture disappears at the edge and there is no visible transmitted detail or reflected highlight across the face
issues.fix: Make the page grain faintly visible through the slab, add a narrow refracted edge band, and give the face a grazing reflection distinct from its cast shadow.

issues.where: the round damage mark on the fourth arrow from the left, and the red-rimmed version at far right in set-A-06.png
issues.what: both holes read as dark filled spots; there is no clearly lit inner wall or identifiable background visible through them
issues.fix: Cut actual openings through the shell, render an irregular charred inner wall and far lip, and show the page or its shadow through the aperture.

issues.where: the far-right cracked arrow and the taped arrow second from left
issues.what: the fine fractures look inked onto the glossy surface instead of splitting it; the repair strips look like flat translucent overlays where they cross the joins
issues.fix: Split the shell along fractures, reveal small exposed sidewalls and dark gaps, and give the tape lifted edges, thickness, and small contact shadows where it bridges the pieces.

issues.where: top-right crop, the paper-feed mechanism directly under the resume
issues.what: the rollers have fine detail, but the complete unit reads as an assembly attached to the face of the page rather than seated in it; the lower casing casts a broad shadow on uninterrupted page texture
issues.fix: Recess the housing into a cutout and show a narrow opening around it, with a dark contact line where the mounting flange meets the page.

issues.where: middle-right crop, the resting arrow's tip and long diagonal edge
issues.what: the white face is nearly featureless at delivery size and the black edge reads as an outline rather than a separate sidewall; the offset shadow conveys height more clearly than the arrow itself
issues.fix: Give the bevel a narrow directional highlight and reveal a distinct sidewall on one edge while keeping the offset cast shadow.

issues.where: bottom-middle crop, the Browse files button
issues.what: the button has a bevel but appears stuck on top of the slab; there is no visible socket or clearance seam around the cap
issues.fix: Recess the cap in a shallow seat with a narrow dark clearance and a tight contact shadow on the side away from the light.

issues.where: far-right arm pose, where the upper arm crosses the arrow face
issues.what: the upper arm tapers into the white face without a visible cuff, mounting point, or separation, so it appears to pass through the shell
issues.fix: Attach the arm to a visible joint at the shell edge or route it visibly in front with a narrow separation shadow.
